facts.business: SRM Energy Limited is engaged in the business of power generation, though it has not conducted any effective business operations during the year under review.

auditor.name: Rajat Associates, LLP, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to material uncertainty regarding going concern assumption and non-recognition of impairment loss on investment in subsidiary in earlier years. Emphasis of matter on change in management and preparation of financial statements on going concern basis despite negative net worth and adverse working capital position.

key_risks: Material uncertainty regarding the Company's ability to continue as a going concern due to negative net worth and current liabilities exceeding current assets
Non-recognition of impairment/diminution in value of investment in subsidiary in earlier years as required under Ind AS 36 and Ind AS 109
No effective business operations conducted during the year
Accumulated losses of Rs. 1,284.66 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026
Change in management and control pursuant to share purchase agreement
facts.related_party_note: Accuracy and completeness of disclosure of related party transactions and compliance with the provisions of Companies Act 2013 and SEBI (LODR) 2015 identified as a key audit matter. The auditor performed procedures to evaluate the disclosure of related party transactions.
